about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: As a former automotive mechatronics technician, I discovered my passion for software development through my enthusiasm for technical systems and structured problem-solving. Today, I build modern web applications with Angular while continuously expanding my frontend and backend skills.
about.paragraph2: What excites me most isn't just writing code—it's understanding how complex systems work. I enjoy learning new technologies, continuously improving my code and creating clean, maintainable solutions.

skills.title: Core Competencies
skills.description: Throughout my frontend projects, I have worked with modern web technologies to build responsive and interactive applications. I enjoy creating clean user interfaces, developing reusable components and continuously improving both usability and code quality.

overlay.title: Don't see the skill you're looking for?
overlay.description: I'm always excited to learn new technologies and expand my skill set. Here are a few topics I'm currently exploring and would love to deepen further.

references.title: What my colleagues say about me

dominik.name: Dominik K.
dominik.text: Nadine shows a very good understanding of modern frontend technologies and applies new concepts quickly and purposefully. Her committed, structured way of working as well as her willingness to share knowledge and support others contribute significantly to a positive learning and team atmosphere.

vladislav.name: Vladislav P.
vladislav.text: I worked with Nadine on the JOIN project at Developer Akademie. Working with her was very pleasant and a lot of fun. She made great progress, especially with Angular and her logical thinking, and stands out with her know-how. Nadine is competent, responsible and a great team partner.
